subject.title: Renderer placeholder leak: `(see attached image)`, `Image reply`, `Audio reply`, `Media reply` leak to human-visible Telegram reply under specific content-classification paths

question: Should this issue remain blocked on a maintainer-directed live Telegram trace before any source repair is assigned?
rationale: Current source separates provider prompt formatting, WebChat transcript projection, and Telegram sending, while the report does not yet identify which boundary first contains the wrong content.

options.title: Require boundary trace
options.body: Capture and redact one failing turn's provider output, `ReplyPayload`, transcript projection, and Bot API request before selecting the repair owner.

options.title: Narrow to provider echo
options.body: Treat only `(see attached image)` as the active hypothesis and investigate whether the model is echoing Pi's prompt anchor into assistant output.

options.title: Accept broad placeholder removal
options.body: Remove or blank all named placeholder families despite their separate intended prompt and WebChat transcript roles.

recommendation.title: Require boundary trace
recommendation.body: Capture and redact one failing turn's provider output, `ReplyPayload`, transcript projection, and Bot API request before selecting the repair owner.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work includes Telegram rendering changes and live-client proof, making this the strongest available owner for deciding the Telegram evidence bar.
